metadata.description: Memory MCP for Claude Code — retrieval-on-demand, not auto-injected context.

plugins.name: bettermemory
plugins.description: Local file-backed memory MCP server. Memories live as plain markdown + YAML in ~/.claude-memory/. The model retrieves them on demand via memory_search; the default is to NOT retrieve, so unrelated context never leaks across conversations. Includes a memory-discipline skill that lands the policy in the system prompt.
